decisions.reason: The measure of how easily something is excited is explicit and appropriate to response sensitivity; it does not imply pathological excess or business sensitivity.
The activity in tissue or a nerve cell after stimulation provides a defined academic physiological sense, not a synonym for every incoming signal.
Removing no-longer-useful bodily material is a clear physiology meaning related to urine; distinguish the process from a particular waste product.
Critical interpretation of a text, especially religious, directly fits the interpretation and scholarly commentary anchors.
The extreme-tiredness sense matches fatigue; the bankruptcy comparison and dated medicinal extraction or vacuum senses are not selected.
Both available definitions repeat exhaustive without explaining full coverage; the old gloss cannot substitute for a self-contained sourced meaning.
No exact source sense or reviewed expand inflection mapping is available; the broad active anchor does not verify growth.
Suitability for achieving an intended purpose is explicit and relevant to practical decisions; unprincipled conduct belongs to a separate unselected sense.
The source supplies quickly as an understandable meaning; avoid claiming that this always means immediately or guarantees efficient results.
The explanation sense is explicit and relevant to defining ideas; retain the source's formal and dated labels rather than silently removing them.
Both definitions depend on explicit without explaining the intended unambiguous-detail meaning; clearer evidence is required for learner-facing release.
A person who explains is a complete meaning appropriate to academic explanation, without requiring a physical demonstration.
Erasing or striking out is explicit and relevant to deletion; the particular permanent-email operation and legal consequences are not generalized.
The criminal-record erasure, destruction or sealing sense is precisely sourced; retain Canada and US labels and make no legal eligibility claim.
Extreme delicate beauty is self-contained and fits beauty, unlike the circular exquisite entry.
Draining a body or body part of blood is an explicit academic medical verb; the source does not support the old claim that every use must be fatal.
No exact factual source entry is available; the technical water-removal gloss is insufficient evidence for release.
No exact factual sense is available for the respiratory term; do not publish clinical detail inferred solely from the old exhalation gloss.
The outside or surface meaning does not support the business economic-externality anchor; those distinct concepts should not be conflated.
A liquid used to extract a substance from another material is a clear chemistry meaning fitting the extraction-solvent context.
Estimating a function outside known values is precise and supports projections from data; it is not restricted to chronological future predictions.
The sole source describes conversion to an extreme form, not mathematical optimization over maxima and minima; the proposed business meaning remains unverified.
The self-contained evidence concerns plant pores, while the proposed business outflow meaning is unsupported and the other definitions repeat exude.
A person who manufactures something matches maker and producer; the counterfeiter and liar senses are not selected.
The available Internet interjection means agreement, not the proposed plural noun for verifiable information; a reviewed factual noun mapping is still missing.
Becoming familiar with something is explicit and appropriate to orientation and training, without implying only physical direction.
The intransitive extreme hunger or thirst meaning is fully explained and relevant to hunger; no death outcome is required.
A separately issued section of a book is the precise publication meaning supported by booklet; anatomical bundles remain separate senses.
Forming a federation or league is explicit and related to federal; retain non-comparability without claiming greater precision in every context.
Wishing joy or happiness and congratulation provide a clear social-communication meaning without invented register examples.
Any member of the cat family is a self-contained biological classification; restrict its reviewed scope to academic animal study rather than an everyday pet synonym.
The carbon solid solution in body-centered cubic iron is a specific metallurgical meaning; restrict to academic materials study and do not present it as all iron.
The English candidate concerns iron-containing remedies, not the intended general metal or Latin name; the proposed iron equivalence remains unsupported.
No exact sourced entry supports the spelling and intended meaning; sensitive medical or legal terminology should not be inferred from the old gloss.
The military aircraft definition is verified, but the sole business bomber anchor does not establish an appropriate topic for this specialist addition.
The only entry is colloquial it figures, not the intended numbered diagrams or images; do not publish a mismatched phrase sense.
Both exact sources describe artisans' supplies, not research results; a familiar spelling is not evidence for the proposed data sense.
The cached definitions introduce conflicting exclusions for flatfish and cartilaginous fish; the intended fish-versus-shellfish teaching meaning needs clearer evidence.
The flammable block used to start a fire is explicit and relevant to equipment vocabulary; do not confuse it with a handheld lighter or a fitness term.
The joined phrase lacks exact evidence and a reviewed fire marshal identity mapping; the old firefighter gloss cannot establish duties.
